questions: How many ZrTe5 junctions did you fabricate and measure, and how many showed SQUID-like interference? The text shows three (Dev 1 to Dev 3, Figs. 3 to 5) and points to Supplementary Table S1 for their dimensions.
Why were the others set aside, if any were?
Which field ranges did you measure beyond the ones shown in Figs. 4 and 5, and how did you choose the range that feeds the Js(x) reconstruction?
What does the second-best junction look like, especially for the in-plane By orientation, which appears for Dev 3 only (Fig. 5c)?
On p. 7 you list "three observations" against trivial boundary channels, and the text I read shows the second and third. What is the first, and which figure carries it?

How were the side edges of the junction flakes formed? Methods describes Ar+ ion milling for the Hall bars; if the junction edges were milled too, a comparison of milled and as-exfoliated edges would help separate edge damage or doping from the facet picture.

Do the Fig. 3d data fit the diffusive long-junction form, Ic proportional to T^3/2 exp(-L/LT), as well as the ballistic form, and how do the fitted level spacings compare with hbar vF/L from your Fermi-surface data and with the Thouless energy from the mean free path in Supplementary Note 2?
